row.notes: TGA pixel converter: (flag, width u32, height u16, bpp 0x10/0x18/0x20, origin-flag byte, src ptr, allocator, mip/format byte, out desc[16]); fills the output texture desc (desc[1]+8/+0xc = w/h, desc[3]=format|0xe), allocates the pixel buffer through allocator vcall +0x18 after Ne_Gfx2Texture_ClampBlockMinAndGetAllocInfo, memsets it and converts 16-bit (SIMD shuffle constants 0x14589a1b0..1e0), 24- and 32-bit source rows to 4-byte pixels, flipping rows when origin bit 0x20 is clear. Returns the pixel pointer. Addon: TGA loader path (texture import). Hypothesis on exact 16-bit layout.
